text:
Alex: Heads-up — customer on Dedicated (acme-corp onprem) reports onprem admin users can't access the private control plane since yesterday's RBAC refactor. Repro in staging.
Mira: which cluster/region? any error snippets? ticket?
Alex: staging cluster: onprem-stg-1. Ticket #INC-4829. Quick log sample: 
```
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z controlplane auth ERROR user=svc-account:onprem-admin action=admin:login result=403 reason=allowlist_check_failed cache_ver=3 policy_id=rbac-refactor-2026-03
```
Alex: The allowlist check appears to return a stale decision (deny) even after the new role binding exists in DB.
Sam: likely cache invalidation bug — our refactor moved allowlist resolution to the async cache layer (PR #4392). Did a deploy land around that time?
infra-bot: deploy/production v2.3.7 completed by ci-bot at 2026-03-20T08:58:12Z (sha: d4c3f2a)
Mira: ok. Alex — can you dump the control plane cache keys and DB binding for that tenant?
Alex: ran the quick checks: 
```
# control-plane cache keys (redis)
$ redis-cli -h controlplane-cache keys "allowlist:acme-corp:*"
1) "allowlist:acme-corp:ver:2"
# DB shows binding exists and policy shows allow=true for svc-account:onprem-admin
```
Alex: but cache still holds ver:2 which our code treats as older than policy ver:3, so it default-denies. cache ttl looks long.
Carmel: immediate mitigation — we can force-clear the allowlist cache for acme-corp and re-sync from DB. Run: 
```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/admin/clear-allowlist-cache" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"org":"acme-corp"}'
```
Carmel: alex, can you run that and confirm?
Alex: ran it — control plane returned 200. Now retry login — customer still seeing 403, logs updated: 
```
2026-03-20T09:25:47Z controlplane auth INFO user=svc-account:onprem-admin action=admin:login result=403 reason=kms:decrypt_denied resource=projects/acme-kms/keys/onprem-role-key
```
Mira: hmm KMS denied decrypt. So two issues: stale allowlist cache (mitigated) and KMS policy preventing control plane from decrypting the binding blob. Which KMS principal are we using in private deployments?
Sam: private control plane uses a cross-account service identity `cp-decryptor@redwood` with restricted grants. Looks like the refactor changed the envelope format, so KMS key policy hasn't been updated to include the new grant. Commit/PR introduced new encryption context field.
Alex: I can confirm the audit log in cloud KMS: 
```
2026-03-20T09:24:58Z kms audit DENY principal=cp-decryptor@redwood action=Decrypt resource=projects/acme-kms/keys/onprem-role-key err=PermissionDenied
```
Carmel: quick mitigation: temporarily add cp-decryptor@redwood to key IAM for acme-kms/onprem-role-key, restrict by condition to that org, and document rollback.
Mira: agree but we need a safer permanent fix: update our deployment playbook to patch KMS key policies during rollout when envelope schema changes. Also add CI check to validate KMS grant for private deployments.
Sam: I'm rolling back the RBAC cache refactor in staging to v2.3.6 to avoid repeated customer impact. I'll open an emergency PR to revert the async layer and add unit+integration tests for cache invalidation.
Alex: after temporary KMS grant, customer confirmed admin login works in staging. I'll escalate to the customer and coordinate prod change.
security-bot: New finding logged: KMS key policy temporarily widened for acme-kms/onprem-role-key (audit required). Please attach incident notes.
Carmel: filing follow-ups: 1) permanent KMS policy update automated in infra repo; 2) control plane cache TTL sanity check + alert when allowlist ver drift > 30s; 3) runbook entry for 'clear-allowlist-cache' + safe KMS grant steps. I'll create tickets.
Mira: add an automated post-deploy verification: for one random private tenant run a login test and KMS decrypt check.
Sam: PRs I'll open: revert cache refactor (hotfix), add integration test for allowlist cache invalidation, add KMS policy migration step in infra.
Alex: thanks everyone. I'll attach logs and steps to INC-4829 and ping support to notify the customer once we've got prod patch scheduled.
Mira: schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow to go over root cause, timeline, and what tests to add.
Carmel: noted — assigning owners and setting due dates in the tickets. :white_check_mark:
Alex: closing the loop here; will update thread after prod rollback/patch.
